fields.help_en:
The departure and arrival city codes. Separate multiple cities with a Chinese comma (，).
If you set this parameter to 0, city control is disabled. Note: If cities are not restricted, pay attention to the hotel travel standard parameters and ensure that travel standards are specified for all cities.
When the allowed booking category is 0, 6, 21, or 25, 3-letter airport codes and 6-digit city codes are allowed.
When the allowed booking category is any other category, only 6-digit city codes are allowed.
The city_set and city_code_set parameters must have a one-to-one mapping.
Note: If the itinerary includes a flight itinerary and the specified city does not have an airport, flight itineraries cannot be booked.

3-letter airport code data (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-flight-city-data.xlsx)
Administrative division city code data (https://btrip-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/base-data/btrip-hotel-city-data.xlsx)

parameters.help_en:
The train ticket budget.

Currency: CNY, in cents.
<warning>For example, if the seat type is "hard sleeper" and there are price differences among the upper, middle, and lower berths, the budget balance will be verified against the highest price during booking.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
火车票预算

货币单位：人民币，分。
<warning>例如坐席同为”硬卧“，上/中/下铺存在价格差异的情况，预订时将按照其中最高价格，校验预算余额。></warning>
parameters.name: train_budget

parameters.help_en:
The car service budget.

Currency: CNY, in cents.
<warning>Uncontrollable factors in ride-hailing scenarios may cause the actual fare to exceed the original estimated price: 1. The passenger changes the destination offline.
Unexpected road conditions such as traffic jams.
The driver adds surcharges, such as tolls, highway fees, and waiting fees.></warning>
parameters.help_zh:
用车预算

货币单位：人民币，分。
<warning>打车场景存在不可控因素，会超出原预估价格：1. 乘客线下修改目的地；
堵车等道路意外情况；
司机添加附加费，如过路费、高速费、等待费等。></warning>
parameters.name: vehicle_budget
